name: Login — retailex_demo kiracısı ile admin girişi firma seçimine ulaşır
description: Kiracı kodu retailex_demo bağlandıktan sonra admin/admin kimlik bilgileriyle giriş yapılır ve firma seçim (organizasyon) adımı görünür.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
If a tenant code field is shown, enter retailex_demo as the tenant code
Click the button to connect to the tenant (Kiracıya bağlan or equivalent)
Enter username admin and password admin in the credential fields
Submit the login form to continue to organization or firm selection
Verify the organization/firm selection step is visible with a firm picker showing Demo Market or firm codes such as 001, and the page is not stuck on an error toast about tenant connection
